variables.name: Test_Name
variables.input:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.start" and event.provider == "jmeter"
| fields name=test.plan.name
| dedup name

variables.name: Test_Run
variables.input:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name)
| fields run_start = test.start.time
| dedup run_start
| sort run_start desc

variables.name: Script_Name
variables.input:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.summary"
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name) AND label[label] != "TOTAL"
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| fields name=test.script.name
| dedup name

variables.name: Step_Name
variables.input:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.summary"
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name) AND label[label] != "TOTAL"
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| filter in(test.script.name, $Script_Name)
| fields name=label[label]
| dedup name

3.title: Total Requests
3.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| sort interval.seq desc
| limit 1
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(label[label], $Step_Name)
| filter label[label] != "TOTAL"
| fields sample=toLong(label[samples.cumulative]), ReqName=label[label], Error_Pct=toDouble(label[`error.pct.cumulative`])
| fieldsAdd status = if(Error_Pct == 0, "🟢", else: "🔴")
| summarize TotalRequest=sum(sample), by:{ReqName, status}

5.title: Success vs Error
5.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(label[label], $Step_Name)
| filter label[label] != "TOTAL"
| fields timestamp, totalReques=toLong(label[delta.samples]), error=toLong(label[delta.errors])

6.title: Success Rate
6.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| sort interval.seq desc
| limit 1
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(label[label], $Step_Name)
| filter label[label] != "TOTAL"
| fields sample=toDouble(label[samples.cumulative]), error=toDouble(label[error.pct.cumulative])
| fieldsAdd success_count = sample*(1 - error/100)
| summarize Success_Rate = 100.0 * sum(success_count) / sum(sample)

9.title: Error Rate
9.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| sort interval.seq desc
| limit 1
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(label[label], $Step_Name)
| filter label[label] != "TOTAL"
| fields sample=toDouble(label[samples.cumulative]), error=toDouble(label[error.pct.cumulative])
| fieldsAdd err_count = sample*(error/100)
| summarize Error_Rate = 100.0 * sum(err_count) / sum(sample)

12.title: Per-Label Stats (latest summary)
12.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 1
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(label[label], $Step_Name)
| fieldsAdd Samples=toLong(label[samples.cumulative]), Error_Pct=toDouble(label[`error.pct.cumulative`])
| fieldsAdd Errors = round(Samples*(Error_Pct/100))
| fieldsAdd Successes = Samples - Errors
| fields
    Label=label[label],
    Samples,
    Successes,
    Errors,
    `Error %`=Error_Pct,
    `Avg (ms)`=toDouble(label[`avg.ms`]),
    `Min (ms)`=toDouble(label[`min.ms`]),
    `Max (ms)`=toDouble(label[`max.ms`]),
    `Throughput/sec`=toDouble(label[`throughput.cumulative.tps`])

28.title: Total Users
28.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| sort interval.seq desc
| limit 1
| fields thread.num.threads

34.title: Live Avg Response Time
34.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| sort interval.seq desc
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(label[label], $Step_Name)
| filter label[label] != "TOTAL"
//| fields avgResTime=toDouble(label[avg.ms])
| makeTimeseries avg(toDouble(label[avg.ms])), interval:30s
//| fieldsAdd arrayAvg(`avg(toDouble(label[avg.ms]))`)
| fieldsAdd arrayLast(`avg(toDouble(label[avg.ms]))`)

40.title: Throughput · Avg Response · Active Users
40.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| filter in(test.plan.name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(test.start.time, $Test_Run)
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(label[label], $Step_Name)
| filter label[label] != "TOTAL"
| fields timestamp, interval.seq, samples=toDouble(label[throughput.interval.tps]), avg_ms=toDouble(label[avg.ms]), active_vus=toLong(thread.num.threads)
| summarize {Throughput=sum(samples), Avg_Response_Time=avg(avg_ms), Active_Users=avg(active_vus)}, by:{timestamp, interval.seq}

104.title: Response Time Percentiles (from spans)
104.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(request_attribute.Load.Test.Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Load.Test.Name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Load.Script.Name, $Script_Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Test.Step.Name, $Step_Name)
| summarize {
    P50=percentile(toDouble(duration)/1000000, 50),
    P90=percentile(toDouble(duration)/1000000, 90),
    P95=percentile(toDouble(duration)/1000000, 95),
    P99=percentile(toDouble(duration)/1000000, 99)
  }, by:{bin(start_time, 30s)}

106.title: Top 10 Slowest Steps (P95)
106.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(request_attribute.Load.Test.Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Load.Test.Name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Load.Script.Name, $Script_Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Test.Step.Name, $Step_Name)
| summarize
    Samples=count(),
    Avg=avg(toDouble(duration)/1000000),
    P50=percentile(toDouble(duration)/1000000, 50),
    P95=percentile(toDouble(duration)/1000000, 95),
    P99=percentile(toDouble(duration)/1000000, 99),
    Max=max(toDouble(duration)/1000000),
    by:{Step=request_attribute.Test.Step.Name, Script=request_attribute.Load.Script.Name}
| sort P95 desc
| limit 10

107.title: Top Failing Steps
107.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(request_attribute.Load.Test.Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Load.Test.Name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Load.Script.Name, $Script_Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Test.Step.Name, $Step_Name)
| summarize
    Total=count(),
    Failures=countIf(request.is_failed == true),
    by:{Step=request_attribute.Test.Step.Name, Script=request_attribute.Load.Script.Name}
| fieldsAdd `Error Rate %` = if(Total > 0, 100.0 * Failures / Total, else: 0)
| filter Failures > 0
| sort Failures desc
| limit 10

108.title: HTTP Status Code Distribution
108.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(request_attribute.Load.Test.Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Load.Test.Name, $Test_Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Load.Script.Name, $Script_Name)
| filter in(request_attribute.Test.Step.Name, $Step_Name)
| filter isNotNull(http.response.status_code)
| summarize Count=count(), by:{Status=http.response.status_code}
| sort Count desc

109.title: Live Throughput Per Second
109.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "com.jmeter.test.stats.live"
| sort interval.seq desc
| parse summary.rows, """JSON_ARRAY{JSON{}}:label"""
| expand label
| filter in(label[label], {"Payment Request Page", "Home Page"})
| filter label[label] != "TOTAL"
//| fields avgResTime=toDouble(label[avg.ms])
| fields timestamp, avgResTime=toDouble(label[avg.ms]), samples=toDouble(label[throughput.interval.tps]), interval.seq
| makeTimeseries sum(samples), interval:30s
| fieldsAdd arrayLast(`sum(samples)`)
